title: Endings
html:
Spoiler Warning

This page contains spoilers. View at your own discretion.

Wesley's Moons has six different endings that can be achieved. The majority of these endings require unlocking a specific moon or moons.

Contents

  • 1 > Acquiring an Ending
  • 2 > Ending 1: Escaped?
  • 3 > Ending 2: Fate Left Unfair
  • 4 > Ending 3: End of Time
  • 5 > Ending 4: Old Mans Rest
  • 6 > Ending 5: Living Ingredient
  • 7 > Ending 6: Art of War
  • 8 > Reward

> Acquiring an Ending

Every ending requires routing to Repress to repair and power an abandoned ship on the exterior. Progress for doing this will be reset upon returning to orbit. An apparatus, two oil barrels, and an untampered operating panel are required to repair the ship. The appratus can be found within the Facility, Expanded Facility, Fractured Complex, and Decrepit Store interiors. The oil barrels can randomly spawn as scrap within the interiors of multiple moons, but most commonly spawn within the interior of Repress. The untampered operating panel is randomly available for purchase in the gift shop on Galetry for ▮7000, can be crafted on Gratar, and randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Empra or Hyx.

To the left of the main entrance, insert an apparatus to open the door at the end of the wire. To the left of the ship in this room, place two oil barrels to fuel the ship. Once fueled, turn towards the monitor, interact with the keypad, interact with the top lever, interact with the bottom lever, and interact with the top lever again to move the ship outside. Run straight out of this room to reach the ship, jump inside, and place the untampered operating panel onto the terminal. If a destiny item has been collected, it can be inserted into the slot to the left of the terminal. Regardless, taking off will cause a cutscene to play and transport the player to the back of the ship once finished.

> Ending 1: Escaped?

Ending 1 is the simplest ending to achieve, as players do not need a destiny item and just take off in the abandoned ship on Repress.

> Ending 2: Fate Left Unfair

To get this ending you must first acquire 3 special apparatuses, these apparatuses are:

-The Bloody Apparatus which is acquired from Demetrica

- Once you land on Demetrica buy either a jetpack or ladder and then proceed to the dome, you'll come to a 3 way fork going left or right will take you towards the main entrance but going straight is where the apparatus is, if you go straight you will enter a square room, dying inside this room without opening the other door will cause the room to become inaccessible for the rest of the day . As soon as you step foot in this room the path behind you will close and a trap will activate in the room, this trap comes in the form of two blocks/walls that stay on the lower level they move counter-clockwise and when they hit a wall they will briefly stop and turn, being in the way of one of these traps will kill the player, so as soon as you enter use the jetpack/ladder to get onto the upper level where the apparatus is, on the opposite end of where the player enters is a door, this door is the way out of the room, and is a unique door, the player can go down and interact with it which will fill up an interaction meter that stays between interactions, once that meter is full the door opens, alternatively and the most recommended option is to bring a key which will immediately open the door or a lockpicker which will open the door after 30 seconds, once this door is open this room will be accessible for the rest of the day and you can take the apparatus at any point.

-The Cosmic Apparatus which is acquired from Cosmocos

-The Royal Apparatus which is acquired from Calist

After acquiring an apparatus you must bring it back to Galetry where you will then insert it into its respective reactor slot inside the secret back room accessed by interacting with the loot bug statue in the back left next to the stairs, once all three have been inserted a new room will open up, inside the room will be a tape for the moon Hyx insert that into the projector and then proceed to the planet, once you're on Hyx proceed into the interior and keep your eye out for a tape there's always one guaranteed to spawn, this tape goes to the moon Empra.

Once on Empra there will be a few steps you must do after taking the cart over to the entrance:

1. Before heading inside the interior, there's a mortar on the left side that must be lowered go up to it and interact with it.

2. Once inside look for the fire exit that takes you out to an upper area that overlooks the cart this is where the crane controls are, there's a button to fire the mortar do that while you're here and then remember where the door is at you will be back here.

3. Now you will want to find two items in the interior the apparatus (word of advice if you have any special interiors installed and they have custom apparatuses you will not be able to continue, it must be the base apparatus), and you will also need to find the nuke, once both have been found take them to the cart and place them in their respective spots.

4. Head back to the crane controls are and get the crane into position, after its in position head down to the cart and head back to the ship, once back at the ship just send the cart back without you on it, after a bit a cutscene will play (this cutscene is not the ending), after the cutscene ends there will be an item that spawns on the ground near the ship called Chunk of Harold, this is a destiny item, grab it and head off to orbit. Players will achieve Ending 2 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene.

> Ending 3: End of Time

Ending 3 is the most complex ending to achieve and follows a mysterious voice guiding the player to various locations. First, players should get access to Berunah. Berunah can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through Dreck, Core, and Faith. Do not route to Berunah after unlocking it.

Next, players need to access Cubatres and retrieve the "Crystal cube" scrap found on the exterior near one of the fire exits. Cubatres can only be accessed through Utril. Players should now route to Berunah with the cube.

After the sandstorm passes on the exterior, a stairway will be revealed directly in front of the main entrance door. Going down this stairway will lead to an area with an interactable statue on the left side. After interacting with this statue, inserting the cube into the hole the statue's light is shining through will reveal a hidden chamber. Inside will be five brooding seeds and a glowing eye at the end of the chamber. Players must return all these brooding seeds to the ship, but can also approach the eye for an explanation on what to do with these seeds and this explanation will be logged in the ship terminal.

Players must place the brooding seeds onto altars on the exteriors of Etern, Filitrios, Fission-C, Gloom, and Utril. Check the Progression section on each moon page to see the specifics of unlocking each of them, and it is highly recommended to unlock and route to Alcatras for the highest chance at finding the Gloom videotape. Placing the brooding seeds will display a warning message and permanently alter the exteriors and interiors of these moons on that save file until the player is fired. Berunah's exterior will also be altered once all five brooding seeds are placed.

After placing all five brooding seeds, players must return to Berunah and the hidden chamber. A "Chunk of Overseer" will now be in the hidden chamber. Near the main entrance, a lever that a statue is looking at will now be interactable nearby. This will raise up the shrine of purification to insert the chunk into, and a cutscene will play shortly afterward.

After the cutscene, the destiny item "Stone of purification" will spawn behind the ship. Players will achieve Ending 3 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene.

> Ending 4: Old Mans Rest

Ending 4 is the quickest of the five endings that provide destiny items to complete and follows the story of a character named Professor Harrington. "Harrington's Research 4" is a destiny item that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior of Utril. Players will achieve Ending 4 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene. For players that wish to understand and experience the story, it is recommended to unlock and route to Cosmocos and Desolation and find logs there as well.

> Ending 5: Living Ingredient

Ending 5 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation and requires completing a unique trial on Release. Release can only be unlocked by following the specific progression route through Crowd, Narcotic, Descent, and Extort. It is important to note that while all of these moons have trials, only Release's trial is required to complete this ending.

To complete this trial:
1. Though not required until the final step, it is advised to find a door with a sign that says "RESHAPE THE INCAPABLE" and remember its location.
2. Find a room with an employee trapped in a machine and remember its location.
3. Find and return three "Machine parts" scrap to this room and insert them into the machine. These parts spawn in smaller server rooms with shelving units behind electrical gates. These electrical gates will deal 99hp to the player if they walk through them while holding machine parts. The intended method to avoid taking damage is to place the parts onto a small platform, walk through the electrical gate and around to the other side of the platform, and rotate the platform to safely transport the parts. However, dropping the parts near the electrical gate, walking through the gate, and grabbing the parts from the other side is much simpler.
4. Press the red button in the room with the employee, grab the gas can underneath it, and find a generator within the interior to fuel with the gas. The generator typically spawns in rooms adjacent to catwalks with a sign saying "BACKUP POWER".
5. Return to the room with the employee, press the red button again, and wait.
6. Once the employee has been "reshaped" and a loud buzzer sound plays, return to the door in step 1. It will now be opened.

After completing the trial, interact with the TV in the now open room. The destiny item "Secret Coordinates" will spawn in the machine next to the TV afterward. Players will achieve Ending 5 after having inserted it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene.

> Ending 6: Art of War

Ending 6 follows the experimentations done by the Trite Control Corporation. It requires completing the trials on Crowd, Narcotic, Descent, Extort, and Release and acquiring the unique ticket scrap from each of them. Players will progress to each moon in the listed order. For the sake of not bloating this guide and making it overwhelming, please read the specifics on completing each trial in the Moon Exclusive Content section of each moon page. For Release's trial specifically players can also read Ending 5 on this page.

Do not attempt Release's trial until all other tickets have been acquired. Once Release's trial is completed and the reward room has been unlocked, do not interact with the TV before inserting all five unique trial tickets into the machine next to the TV as prompted. Submitting any less than all five tickets will result in Ending 5. Interacting with the TV after submitting all five tickets will instead spawn the destiny item "Very secret coordinates" in the machine next to the TV. Players will achieve Ending 6 after having inserted it it into the destiny item slot in the abandoned ship on Repress and watching the cutscene.

> Reward

After completing any ending except Ending 1, players will unlock a hidden moon called End. This moon is not a traditional moon and instead serves as the credits for Wesley's Moons. This moon can also be used to farm knives, shotguns, and shovels.
